summary: The Acer Predator Neo 16 laptop is experiencing issues with the RTX 4050 GPU, specifically glitches and crashes during gaming, inability to run on battery power, unstable performance when plugged in, boot issues with black screens or artifacts, and MATS/MODS errors on all memory chips.
detected_fault: The issue appears to be related to the VRAM power delivery, specifically the memory controller and MOSFETs. The symptoms suggest a failure in the power rail, causing unstable voltage supply to the memory chips.
suggested_solution: Replacing the MOSFETs and capacitors in the memory power rail may resolve the issue.
